$comment: The one list of dependency versions every channel must agree on (PPA, vcpkg registry, Homebrew tap, Flatpak manifest, RPM and Arch jobs, macOS scripts). tools/check-versions.py reads it and fails on drift. 'tarball' names the PPA orig tarball published as a release asset of ayourk/hobbycad-vcpkg (tag 'sources'); 'vcpkg' is the version string the registry uses when it differs, and 'vcpkg_port_version' the port-version when a new cut keeps that string. 'scope' is runtime for what the shipped program links (every channel must match) or devtest for what only devtest/depcheck and the developer channels (PPA, registry, tap) carry. 'source' gives the URL and SHA-256 of what the Linux and MSYS2 jobs build from source; tools/check-versions.py --write-pins renders those into scripts/ci/pins.sh, which the scripts/ci/ build scripts read and the checker keeps in step. 'ppa_source' names the source package in ppa:ayourk/hobbycad, which scripts/ci/check-launchpad.py compares with the pin.

nlohmann-json.note: PPA package nlohmann-json3 3.12.0-1~ppa1 for noble and jammy only. Resolute keeps the archive's reverted 3.12.0.really.3.12.0.really.3.11.3 (Aaron, 2026-09-14): a plain 3.12.0 sorts below it and an epoch is not worth the permanence.
